item.title: Business News | Aye Finance Pilots Generative AI Model for Image-based Underwriting of Trading Businesses
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. New Delhi [India], March 4: Aye Finance, India's leading provider of business loans to the underserved micro-scale MSMEs, has completed a pilot that uses the predictive capability of Gen AI technology, which will enhance its formal credit to the trading businesses in tier 2 and beyond cities. The cutting-edge solution developed in-house utilises Generative AI and Machine Learning (ML) models to estimate business sales directly from images

item.title: CUET PG Admit Card 2026 Out at exams.nta.nic.in/cuet-pg: NTA Releases Hall Ticket for March 6-10 Exams, Know Steps To Download
item.description: The NTA released CUET PG 2026 admit cards today, March 4, for the first phase of exams starting March 6. Candidates can download hall tickets from exams.nta.nic.in using their application number. Over 4.1 lakh aspirants will test across 157 subjects. Admit cards for later dates will be released in a staggered manner.
